**Risk flags:**  
- No major flags  

**Overview:**  
Global Murni Plastik Sdn. Bhd. is a private limited manufacturing company that produces furniture from rubberwood. It is incorporated on 29 September 2017 and operates in Perak, Malaysia. The firm has five directors, a share capital of 5,000,000, and its largest shareholder holds 42.83 % of the equity. Reported revenues are 23,163,445; 23,742,633; and 24,762,011 (currency not specified). Equity figures are 17,014,758; 17,699,924; and 18,523,479 respectively. No legal cases are recorded against the company.
